response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM counts) SELECT c.tradekind, c.cnt AS count, (c.cnt * 1.0) / s.total_cnt AS share_of_total, c.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM counts c CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt > s.avg_cnt
